email_body:
Dear Spotable team,

I'm applying for the Growth Marketer role. My background sits where SEO, web and AI meet: I build and optimize landing pages, work with Google Analytics, Search Console and Google Ads, and use LLM tooling daily to automate research, content and audits.

What draws me to Spotable is the mandate to own the funnel end to end — from ad to signup to activation — and to test new channels rather than maintain existing ones. I've done that at a smaller scale: hand-coding a landing page with a WebGL hero and an enquiry flow, running iterative audits that measurably raised a site's search-health score, and tracking results in Semrush, Ahrefs and GA4.

I'd welcome the chance to bring that experimental, hands-on approach to your acquisition and activation funnel.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Spotable team,

I'm writing to apply for the Growth Marketer position. Spotable's focus — measurable acquisition, activation, and a willingness to test AI-driven channels such as ChatGPT Ads — matches the way I already work.

I'm a digital marketer with a technical background. I build websites and landing pages myself, then measure what they do. On mirook.com I implemented structured data, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, ran iterative technical SEO and GEO audits, and measurably raised the site's search-health score. On baverok.com I designed and hand-coded a landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data and a free site-check enquiry flow — a complete path from interest to a lead, not just a page.

Day to day I work with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Ads, so monitoring conversion metrics and drawing conclusions from them is familiar ground. I use LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) daily for research, content and audits, and I've built MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tooling — which is why emerging acquisition channels, including AI-assisted advertising, are interesting rather than intimidating.

Two things I'd bring to Spotable. First, the ability to ship: I don't wait for someone else to build the page or fix the markup. Second, a bias toward understanding why something works — I'd rather run one clean experiment, document the result and act on it than launch ten campaigns nobody learns from. A weekly experiment report is exactly the kind of rhythm I like working in.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, fluent in English, and comfortable working independently. I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can help turn marketing activity into measurable growth.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cv_highlights:
- Hands-on with Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs — the data behind acquisition and conversion metrics.
- Builds and ships landing pages himself: baverok.com is a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, accessible markup and a free site-check enquiry flow.
- GEO and AI search visibility: JSON-LD schema, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file on mirook.com, plus iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score.
- AI as a daily working habit: Claude and ChatGPT for research, content and audits, prompt engineering, MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools, plus Python automation.
- Works independently across freelance SEO/WordPress projects and a remote role at Episto, running on-page SEO, content and performance reporting for multiple client sites.
